snippet.title: Hegemarch – Official Trailer | Free Space RTS Roguelite
snippet.description:
Play free in your browser; no signup, no install: https://hegemarch.com

The last Hegemarch fell, and the sector went dark.
Choose your dynasty, colonize planets, command fleets and fight rival AI dynasties for control of the stars. When your empire falls, start a new run and come back smarter.

- Real-time empire building and fleet battles
- A new sector every run, plus a daily run everyone shares
- Every planet, ship, explosion and note of music generated in code
- Instant play on desktop browsers

itch.io: https://hegemarch.itch.io/hegemarch

#Hegemarch #IndieGame #StrategyGame
